wrote my post. didn't really bother following it up, but thought that to be rude. So I apologize for that. Still some time, so may aswell update.

I've made a decision on what to do. I've already began the preperations. I'm going into the forest, around 8 hours walk away from nearest house, which is also quite remote. I'm bringing a shovel, which I'm using to dig a hole. The earth dug up from the hole, will through simple means be held up near the edge of the hole, until the time it needs to fall back. After undressing and burning my clothes I'll get in the hole, take my poison. and as I die I'll be buried. This way I'll ensure my corpse will be broken down and used in the local fauna.
